items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I enjoyed the session, you know, we played, it was an hour... And both bands met up.

ctx.x: You know Louis Caput. No, no, no. I can't tell you who that is. I'll have to ask him around. Well you try. Ask Dave Bailey what you're saying. Yeah. Or this boy out there, you'll holler out today, what was his name again?
